R0.name: ITT Primary Baseline
R0.description: Raw provider output scored as-is under Intention-To-Treat primary protocol.

R1.name: Deterministic Local Repair
R1.description: Apply local deterministic JSON extraction and syntax fixes (strip markdown fences, fix trailing commas) without provider calls.

R2.name: Identical Prompt Retry
R2.description: Re-issue 1 identical request to provider upon malformed/failed response.

R3.name: Constrained Repair Prompt
R3.description: Re-issue 1 targeted follow-up prompt including error diagnostic message and strict JSON format schema instruction.
